about: A neighborhood bar at 2601 St. Charles Road run by owner Joe, who invites everyone to come in and have a good time. It has a TouchTunes jukebox, darts, a claw machine, video gaming and poker machines, an ATM and packaged liquor to go, and hosts parties.
tagline: Bellwood's neighborhood hideaway: jukebox, darts and good company
notes: This is a bar, not a restaurant; the site lists no food menu. Legal name on its gaming vouchers is 'Hideaway Lounge, Inc.' (aka Hide-Away Lounge & Liquor Store). Video gaming is a major feature, which may not suit a culinary trail. Contact emails on site: joeeads58@aol.com, joeeads74@gmail.com.
